run.name: Block, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (XYZ)
run.summary: Block has a moderate, liquidity-supported credit profile. Total debt to filed-basis EBITDA is 4.67x against 1.69x on management's adjusted basis, and legal payments of USD 764 million are accrued but unpaid. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total net revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, filed basis (operating income plus D&A), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt is note principal 5,775.0 plus Warehouse Facilities 1,543.5 (7,318.5); EBITDA is LTM operating income 1,188.7 plus depreciation and amortization 378.2 (1,567.0), no add-backs; net debt deducts cash and cash equivalents 7,859.3 only (-540.8). Warehouse debt is secured on SPE assets; on notes alone the ratio is 3.69x. Covenant definition differs and is not printed.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 1,567.0 over LTM cash paid for interest 393.1 (FY2025 246.3 less nine months 2025 124.2 plus nine months 2026 270.9). Cash paid for interest is a consolidated figure not split between notes, warehouse and deposits; warehouse interest expense is booked in general and administrative expense (10-Q Q3 page:30). On Adjusted EBITDA 4,336.4 the ratio is 11.03x.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents (10-Q Q3 page:4); revolver undrawn, no letters of credit issued (10-Q Q3 page:28). Company-stated total liquidity is 10,064.0 including restricted cash and securities; warehouse availability of 809.3 is excluded. Cash is not net of obligations to customers (customers payable exceeds customer funds).

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The leverage covenant level, guarantors and executed debt documents are not supplied, so headroom and ranking cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: The covenant level is not printed, and adjusted earnings add back large legal charges and share-based pay.
